74424.commentary: (ITIa) avuṭṭhikasamo'ti avuṭṭhikameghasamo. ekacco hi megho satapaṭala-sahassapaṭalo hutvā uṭṭhahitvā thananto gajjanto vijjotanto ekaṃ udakabindum'pi apātetvā vigacchati, tath'ūpamo ekacco puggalo'ti dassento āha avuṭṭhikasamo'ti.
